messages:
kai: Postmortem follow-up: recurrent night noise from cache_p99 alerts. Need owners, quick mitigations, and validation metrics. Short thread please.

anita: I'll run an alert audit and propose per-cluster thresholds (not global). ETA 48h.

rob: I'll do PD dedupe + routing lanes. Plan: dedupe_key=host|alert, host cooldown 10m, cluster cooldown 30m; night-window (23:00-07:00) route duplicates to #alerts-ops unless incident_count>2. ETA 24h.

oncall-bot: Reminder: changes that affect paging require a runbook PR in infra/runbooks. Tag @eng-sre.

kai: quick mitigations: 1) temp silence for night window (opsctl dry-run), 2) feature-flagged threshold changes, 3) dedupe rule in PD. Owners: anita -> thresholds (48h), rob -> dedupe/routes (24h), kai -> dashboard + baseline (tomorrow AM).

anita: sample threshold tweak (staging behind flag):
```yaml
- alert: cache_p99_high
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(cache_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, cluster)) > 140
  for: 3m
  labels:
    severity: page
```
Will parameterize per-cluster.

rob: PD rule sketch: if open_incidents_for_host_last_15m == 0 -> page; else post to #alerts-ops. Deduplicate by host+alert. Will draft and link PD policy.

oncall-bot: Auto: please attach eval plan to runbook PR.

kai: validation metrics (keep small): total_cache_alerts/day, night_pagers(23:00-07:00), unique_hosts_alerting, suppressed_to_page_ratio. Target: reduce night pagers by 75% in 2 weeks without missed criticals.

anita: will attach baseline to dashboard tomorrow AM.

rob: drafting PD rules now and will post PR for runbook.

kai: quick sync Friday 09:30 PT. Keep updates one-liners only. Thanks all :thumbsup:
